answer: Require each new agent to burn a one-time enrollment ticket that can only be minted during a short registration inlet at the start of each epoch, capped at a fixed number of tickets. A bridge contract then links the ticket to a single identity and burns it forever, so one ticket cannot spawn two agents. Honest agents treat this like paying a small wharf fee once, while an attacker needing ten thousand fake identities must buy ten thousand tickets across many epochs, turning instant forgery into a slow, expensive, traceable queue.
